RAM-only PackedFS capacity simulator for normal LCD DE4.2 / App680 (compiled DE4.2-b2).
The six storage-engine files are copied unchanged from the exact firmware source.
The storage format and constants are unchanged. Source binding, engine identity, and compiler hashes are in the adjacent JSON files.
Use web/scripts/build-capacity-de42.py with the pinned official WASI SDK 34.
Runtime SDK/GC instrumentation is omitted from the RAM-only simulator; this is not a firmware timing or physical device-memory measurement.
